extDescription.message: Run Legends of Idleon in a small always-on-top Picture-in-Picture window.

unsupportedBrowser.message: Document Picture-in-Picture is not supported in this browser.

buttonTooltip.message: Open or close Picture-in-Picture for Idleon. Right-click to hide this button.

overlayBody.message: Close the PiP window to return the game to the page

toastButtonHidden.message: Idleon PiP button hidden. Press Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P to restore.

toastClickButton.message: Click the Idleon PiP button to open Picture-in-Picture

errorBlockedAutoBody.message: Chrome only allows this PiP window to open after a direct user action, like clicking the PiP button or the extension icon. The extension is working, but the browser rejected the automatic open.

errorBlockedManualBody.message: Chrome only allows this PiP window to open after a direct user action. Please try clicking the PiP button on the page or the extension icon.

errorUnavailableBody.message: This browser or browser setting does not currently allow Document Picture-in-Picture on this page.

errorUnknownBody.message: Chrome rejected the PiP request for an unknown reason.

errorMissingParent.message: Game container has no parent node.
